summary.label: Verdict
summary.text: invoice.js is one 140-line function mixing tax rules, discounts, formatting and email. Worth four small steps, not a rewrite.

summary.label: Weak spots
points: The 20% tax rule is written out in three places
The name 'grand' hides that it is the total including tax

summary.label: Found, not fixed
points: Gold customers' discount rounds down while every other tier rounds to nearest

summary.label: Recommendation
points: Keep the gold rounding as-is and ask finance (F1)
Side with the Minimalist on T1

outcome.title: invoice.js after the approved steps
outcome.caption: The tier switch leaves as computeDiscount(), tax becomes one constant, exportCsv() is gone. Still one module, one caller.

decisions.title: Gold discount rounds down
detail: Gold floors the 10 % discount; silver and bronze round
decisions.why: Changes invoices customers already received. Step 0 pins today's behavior either way.

for.point: One rounding rule for every tier removes a Repeated Switch.

against.point: Customer-facing money: finance must sign off before we touch it.
Pinned as-is in Step 0; fixing it is a separate fix: commit, test-first.

decisions.title: Characterize invoice totals (safety net)
detail: Pins 9 behaviors: each tier's discount, the 0 € order, tax on shipping, the email subject
Proves they bite by flipping the rounding and the tax constant

for.point: Today's two tests only cover the silver path.

decisions.title: Extract Constant: TAX_RATE
decisions.detail: The 20 % rate is written three times: once `0.2`, twice `1.2`.

for.point: A tax change today means three edits.
KEEP: removes a present, bug-prone duplication.
'grand' is read 11 times and never says what it holds.
No callers in the repo or in git history since it was added.

decisions.title: Extract Function: computeDiscount(tier, total)
decisions.detail: Pulls the tier switch out of the main function so the upcoming 'platinum' tier is a one-place edit.

for.point: Make the change easy, then make the easy change: platinum lands next sprint.

against.point: Fine only if it takes the rounding with it; a shallow wrapper would leak it.

code.before:
if (tier === 'gold') discount = …
else if (tier === 'silver') discount = …
else discount = …

decisions.title: Currency symbol printed after a space ('12,00 €')
'Discount: -0.00' printed when there is no discount

tensions.topic: Split invoice.js into calculate / format / send modules?

sides.position: Three reasons to change (tax law, layout, mail provider) live in one file. Separate them now while the tests are fresh.
After S1–S4 the file is 110 lines with one caller. Three modules would be shallow and must be read together. Split when a second caller appears.

rejected.title: DiscountStrategy interface with one class per tier
rejected.reason: One use today; the switch is not repeated anywhere. Killed by the Minimalist gate.
